testcase.name: a hand-set size is not a reason to refuse to grow, and is not written to
the busy tile is drawn one size bigger
a wide tile is already the widest a phone drew, so it stays wide
a busy tile that is not on the grid changes nothing
two tiles can be busy at once
the bottom row is left alone because its tiles are not in the grid order
growing is undone by simply not applying it any more
nothing busy leaves the order exactly as it is
an empty grid is not a special case
a busy tile that is already wide costs no new list
every other tile keeps its size and its place
a small tile grows to medium and a medium one to wide
a process that died mid-song leaves nothing behind, because growth is not stored
